_note: Placeholder answers for scripts/greenhouse-dryrun.mjs, captured from https://careers.datadoghq.com/detail/8041594/?gh_jid=8041594 (Datadog — Manager I, Engineering - Onboarding Growth). This is the embedded counterpart of greenhouse-dryrun.example.json: Datadog hosts the posting on its own careers site and mounts the Greenhouse form in a greenhouse.io/embed/job_app iframe, so the run needs the board slug the URL does not carry — pass --board=datadog. The keys are this posting's question ids and are job-specific: for any other job, regenerate them with buildAnswerTemplate(compactSchema(raw)).answers. Every value here is fake on purpose — the dry run fills a live form and never submits it, so nothing but placeholder data may go into it. There are 20 answer keys here, 16 of which resolve, including one multi-select whose key ends in [] — question_67918863[] takes a list of city labels, not a string. Datadog's location_questions is empty, so it has no candidate-location, and there is no `country` key: the page's `input#country` is the phone widget's dial-code selector, not an address field, so this adapter does not answer it. Keys beginning with _ are comments and are dropped before validation.
_resume: The value under `resume` is ignored: the fill script uploads the <resume.pdf> argument for that one field. It only has to be non-empty so the answer resolves, which is also what makes the required `resume_text` twin drop out.
resume_text: Placeholder. Dropped in favour of the uploaded resume file.
